ci_automated_drill.description: Disposable-kind-cluster rehearsal of the backup/restore/replay/poison-message tooling, run on pull requests touching the covered paths and on manual workflow_dispatch. Exercises the real scripts against a real (locally built, not mocked) PostgreSQL, Kafka, and application deployment inside an ephemeral cluster. Does not exercise managed or production infrastructure -- see external_blockers, which remain open.

validations: scripts/single-server/backup.sh and backup-postgres-only.sh produce a restorable artifact against a real PostgreSQL StatefulSet
backup-postgres-only.sh does not scale the control-plane deployment to zero (no-downtime backup)
scripts/single-server/restore.sh (restore-v1.sh) refuses to run against a namespace missing the signalchord.io/restore-target annotation
scripts/single-server/restore.sh restores Postgres to an exact per-table row-count and md5(id) checksum match against the pre-failure baseline
rails db:migrate:status reports zero pending migrations after restore

scripts/single-server/replay-kafka.sh resets a real consumer group's offsets against a real broker and redelivery does not create a duplicate row (idempotent find_or_initialize_by(stable_id:) in Internal::V1::AlertsController)

a permanent Python poison message (services/python_common/poison_message.py, graph-projector) is published to <topic>.dlq with required source/error metadata, the source offset advances past it, and a healthy message behind it on the same partition is processed
a permanent Go poison message (services/internal/kafkautil, realtime-gateway) shows the same DLQ, metadata, and offset-advance-past-poison behavior
a transient failure is not published to any DLQ and does not advance the committed offset

not_covered: managed/production PostgreSQL and Kafka infrastructure (this drill runs an in-cluster PostgreSQL StatefulSet and a single-broker Kafka StatefulSet inside a disposable kind cluster, not any managed service)

object_storage, neo4j and secrets_and_configuration restore paths (the full backup/restore bundle includes these, but this drill's automated verification only reconciles PostgreSQL row counts and checksums)
cross-broker Kafka mirroring or DR replication
